speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cervical Spondylotic Myelopathy (likely C5-C6 or C6-C7 level) given the chronic neck pain, bilateral upper extremity paresthesias, progressive intrinsic hand muscle weakness (difficulty with fine motor tasks), and history of motor vehicle accident. The patient's diabetes may be contributing to neuropathy, but the focal weakness and neck pain suggest a compressive cervical spine etiology. Recommend MRI of the cervical spine with contrast for definitive imaging.
